description: This file contains stub implementations for secure system calls, including wrappers for system commands, process control, and file descriptor management, primarily used for testing or mocking in unit tests.

methods.name: v_secure_system
methods.description: Executes a command string with parsing and process control, returning the exit status.

methods.name: v_secure_popen
methods.description: Creates a pipe and executes a command, returning a FILE pointer for reading or writing.

methods.name: v_secure_pclose
methods.description: Closes the FILE pointer opened by v_secure_popen and waits for the process to terminate.

methods.name: secure_system_call_p
methods.description: Executes a command with argument array, forking and waiting for completion.

methods.name: secure_system_call_vp
methods.description: Executes a command with variable arguments, forking and waiting for completion.

methods.name: contains_secure_separator
methods.description: Stub function for checking secure separators, returns -1.
